_note: Cross-family blend (Chinese + Steppe): a sinicized steppe empire - Yuan/Kublai-era Mongols who conquered a settled Chinese land and took on its statecraft, the Great Khan ruling as Son of Heaven. Backbone = Mongol-Turkic (steppe: phonology, the Khan ladder, the decimal host); overlay = Sinitic (east_asian: the cheng cities, the Confucian bureaucracy, the darughachi governors, the Mandate of Heaven). civ = feudal. Seeds/shifts Lawful or Neutral. Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Mongol-Turkic/Chinese registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon from both parents (Steppe primary, Sinitic variant), never real gods.

phonology.palette: Mongol-Turkic backbone (vowel harmony; kh, gh, ch, sh, ng, q; -ai/-tai/-chi) with a Sinitic overlay (monosyllabic Chinese loanwords in the bureaucratic register, -cheng/-shan toponyms, court titles); theophoric on the Steppe morphs (Marakhai-, Tulai-) with Sinitic variants (Maluo-, Tuli-).
phonology.phonotactics: CV/CVC, no initial clusters; vowel harmony; the Sinitic overlay adds tight monosyllables in offices and city-names.

morphology.patronymic_form: patronymic father + -in (steppe); the sinicized court takes a Chinese surname (xing) + given-name; the ovog (clan) for the horde.
morphology.compounding_rule: [quality|animal](stem) + feature: Har-uul (black-mountain); the Sinitic overlay yields [quality]-cheng (Jin-cheng, golden-city) for the great walled cities.

title_ladder.government: feudal (a sinicized steppe empire: the Great Khan rules as Son of Heaven over a Chinese-model bureaucracy of darughachi governors; the decimal host and the ovog-clans beneath)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Mongol-Turkic backbone, ascending, with a Sinitic administrative overlay. Noyan (noble) barony; Tarkhan (border-lord) march; Darughachi (the Yuan governor-overseer) county, over a Chinese Lu (circuit); Mingghan-Noyan (commander of a thousand) duchy; Beki (great chief) principality; Khan, styled Wang (Chinese prince), kingdom; Khagan, styled Huangdi (the Great Khan as Son of Heaven, holding the Mandate), over the Yeke Ulus. The Confucian bureaucracy serves the horde-aristocracy. (Rank titles are the real Mongol-Turkic/Chinese register, allowed.)

people_name_convention.order: horde-kin: personal + father's name (-in) + ovog (clan); the sinicized court: a Chinese surname (xing) + given-name, plus a steppe honor.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the steppe aristocracy keep Mongol names; the bureaucracy and court take Chinese names.
people_name_convention.theophoric: names invoke the Eternal Sky and the war-powers + an element: Munke- (eternal), -baatar (hero); the court adds Chinese Tian- (heaven). e.g. Munke-baatar, Tian-Tulai.

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon (Steppe primary, from family_steppe theonym_set; Sinitic variant, from family_east_asian theonym_sets.sinitic), never real steppe/Chinese gods. Xiongan seeds/shifts Lawful or Neutral; its stance follows its CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment). The Mongol Eternal Sky and the Chinese Mandate of Heaven are fused: when Lawful, the One (Eterun, Sinitic Aiteng) is revered as the ordered Heaven that grants the Mandate; the ovoo-cairn and the imperial miao-temple keep the rites.
religion.the_one: Eterun (< Aeternus; Sinitic Aiteng) - the Eternal Sky / Highest Heaven; revered as the source of the Mandate when Lawful, acknowledged as the distant Heaven when Neutral

sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Tulai (Sin. Tuli-di) - sun and judgment; Lawful power
sample_deity_renames.Orlandus: Orloch (Sin. Aolan-jun) - iron-oath, war; Lawful power
sample_deity_renames.Numeno: Nomon (Sin. Numeng-jun) - sky-wisdom, the scribe; Lawful power
sample_deity_renames.Maraxus: Marakhai (Sin. Maluo) - the war-fire; Chaotic power, demonized

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: revere the One (Eterun/Aiteng, the Eternal Heaven and Mandate) and the Lawful powers (Tulai, Orloch, Nomon, Gajan), demonize the Chaotic powers (Marakhai, Bachid, Lusantai)
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: all powers ambivalent; foreground the ancestral dead (the imperial ancestor-cult) and the powers of place

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the demonized set (the Chaotic powers, when Lawful) take dread epithets: Maraxus -> Marakhai the War-Fire (Sin. Maluo the Demon-Marshal); Vacidus -> Bachid the Devourer; Lusanto -> Lusantai the Coin-Serpent.

clergy_ladder.9: Tianshi (celestial master, the court's high priest)

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Ovoo (sacred cairn) of [power] on the high places, and the imperial Miao (temple) in the cheng-cities: 'the Ovoo of Eterun', 'the Miao of Tulai'.
religion.saints_pattern: the great khans and worthy ministers enrolled in the celestial register and the ancestor-temple; the hero-baatars become sky-riders.

holy_symbol_motifs.Eterun: the open sky-disc above the dragon-throne
holy_symbol_motifs.Tulai: a winged sun above the law-stele
holy_symbol_motifs.Orloch: an iron oath-ring crossed with the tug-standard

banks_patterns.ships: river-junk and steppe horse-standards: 'the Sky-Dragon', 'Storm of the Gol', 'the Jade Banner'
banks_patterns.military_units: the decimal host with Chinese banners: the [khan] Tumen (10,000) / the [color] Banner: 'the Wolf Tumen', 'the Azure Banner'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: abandoned ordu-camps and sacked cheng-cities: 'the Kurgan of [khan]', 'the Ruined Cheng of [name]'
